newEditionChecklist: Confirm date/chamber/territories and reconcile the fresh official registry.
Acquire each applicable programme/annex with original URLs, byte hashes and missing-source searches.
Read every used document in full, one by one; preserve exact context, caveats and source-specific applicability.
Cross-reference fresh policies and directly author question/rubric/value/citation records; never inherit 2023 values, silence or coalition adoption.
Calibrate all five answers and verify actual browser meaning/privacy/selection/evidence before local acceptance.
Compile a separately versioned new edition using an explicitly scoped compiler; the 2023-only compiler rejects relabelled inputs.
Preserve 2023 immutable snapshots, corrections, pinned sessions and authenticated restore/rollback.
Prepare concrete provider/domain/cost/host privacy/source permission evidence and request PUBLIC-LAUNCH only for the final external action.
limitations: The negative test uses labelled hypothetical unread input only, never a future programme or public bundle.
This checklist does not acquire, fabricate or certify a future election.
